scope: CALL/HALT program plus independently loadable 32-lane contexts; MAC/DOT/vector slice, not full recovery or legacy tile64/control256/service128.
packing: fields in JSON order, least-significant field first; unsigned words carry two's-complement signed immediates
context_op_authority: config/v4_pe_interface.json; these numeric PE opcode values are reused, stream context64 remains a new ABI.

numeric.accumulator: zero-initialized signed64 checked prefix; includes earlier lanes even when last frame masks them
numeric.mac_coefficient_operand: selected B operand must sign-extend C18 in mode0
numeric.full_product: signedS27 times signedS27, decomposed unsignedlow17 + signedhigh10 through one27x18 multiplier perPE
numeric.last_acc: raw lane totals rounded once by descriptor shift to S27; allcontextsMAC
numeric.sum_acc: sum all32 raw lane totals checked signed64; descriptor shift must0; allcontextsMAC; scalar response
numeric.each: MOV/ADD/SUB/MUL only; descriptor shift0, peroperation native rounding

loader.order: begin, all program words, then each template descriptor at lane0 and contexts at lanes1..32; only final template context has last
loader.complete: image_valid only after complete validated package; load_status held; references validated before CALL dispatch
loader.hash: trusted host verification, not RTL SHA256
loader.partial_load: image invalidated at accepted begin; START blocked until package complete and load_status consumed
loader.cancel: flush pending run/done/services; preserve previously completed image only; incomplete image invalid
loader.reset: clear image/control metadata; RAM module retains bits but top validity resets

memory.organization: 16 physical TDP banks with two logical lanes perbank, 1024x36 geometry27bits used
memory.grant: one32element read ORwrite grant perclock; two read credits countRAMstage+responseFIFO; writes noresponse
memory.read_latency: response firstvalid after second edge counting accepted request edge as first
memory.ownership: top sole memory client while program running; host idle only; scratch blocks480..511 inaccessible to host/program references

command.scope: one CALL outstanding, multiple frames in compute; vector destination publishes only after fullCALL succeeds
command.cancel: silent flush; failed/cancelled vectorCALL invalidates all lanes of affected destination blocks; earlierCALLs outside those blocks stay valid; no wholeprogramrollback claim
command.alias: all outputs staged in32scratch blocks; reads finish beforedestinationcopy; destination invalidduringcopy untilcomplete
command.generation: program immutable duringrun; job/tag/fmt captured; responseidentitychecked; cancelflushesallendpoints
command.each_destination: dst+frame wheninc_dst1, same dst wheninc_dst0; copies inframeorder,lastactivewritewins; replaceblockvaliditywithunionofCALLwritemasks
command.tail: fullmask except finalframetailmask; LAST_ACC maskunionofacceptedframes; SUM_ACC includesallpreviousactivepartials

capabilities.first_slice_operator: explicit frame vectors in sharedRAM; livePhi/B frontend integration is later
